scholarships.title: HKUST Global Learners Scholarship
scholarships.official_source: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)

existing.description: The Global Learners Scholarship was established by HKUST to support the University's strategic objective of enhancing the diversity of its student community. Applicants do not apply for it: all undergraduate programme applicants from underrepresented nationalities are considered automatically, and the decision is normally communicated with the offer of admission. Awardees receive a full tuition waiver that is renewable for the normal duration of the study, subject to satisfactory academic performance, and a School or Programme Office may add a top-up as long as the combined limit of full tuition fee plus an HK$60,000 annual allowance is not exceeded. The University opened its online application system for 2027/28 entry in early October 2026, with a Priority Round deadline of 25 November 2026.
eligibility: Must apply to an HKUST undergraduate programme with international qualifications
Must hold a nationality the University treats as underrepresented, which is the basis on which HKUST targets this scholarship
Must be a non-local applicant seeking admission to HKUST
No separate scholarship application is required - consideration is automatic with the admission application
existing.eligibility_summary: All undergraduate programme applicants at HKUST whose nationality is described by the University as underrepresented. There is no separate scholarship application; the admission application is the application.

Scholarship decisions are normally communicated together with the offer of admission
coverage: Full tuition waiver, renewable for the normal duration of study

requirements: Apply to an HKUST undergraduate programme through the University's online application system

Meet the Priority Round deadline of 25 November 2026 for the earliest consideration

Await the scholarship decision, which is normally notified with the offer of admission
existing.selection_notes: HKUST states that students do not have to apply for the scholarship and that all undergraduate programme applicants from underrepresented nationalities are automatically considered, with the decision normally notified when the offer of admission is received. The University states that the English version of the terms always prevails in case of any discrepancy with the Chinese version. Separately from this award, HKUST also runs merit-based admissions scholarships awarded to top students on academic merit and non-academic achievements, non-academic scholarships requiring separate applications (Future Leaders Award and Beyond Academic Admissions Scholarship), a University Admissions Scholarship for Other Qualifications Holders and a Scholarship Scheme for International/Asian Olympiad Medalists.
existing.best_fit: Non-local applicants to HKUST undergraduate programmes who hold a nationality HKUST treats as underrepresented and who want a full tuition waiver renewable for the whole degree without a separate scholarship application.
existing.notes: The award is a full tuition waiver rather than a cash grant, and HKUST does not publish the tuition amount or the number of awards on the scholarship page, so funding_amount is left null. The HK$60,000 figure on the page is the ceiling for an optional School or Programme Office top-up, not the value of the scholarship itself.
existing.duration: Renewable for the normal duration of the undergraduate degree, subject to satisfactory academic performance
existing.application_period: Open now for HKUST's 2027/28 entry: the online application system opened in early October 2026, the Priority Round deadline is 25 November 2026, applications are accepted on a rolling basis from 26 November 2026 onwards, offers are announced in late December 2026 and the application deadline is 30 June 2027. The scholarship itself requires no separate application.
existing.deadline_display: 25 November 2026 - HKUST Priority Round deadline for applicants with international qualifications applying for 2027/28 entry; applications continue on a rolling basis from 26 November 2026 and the overall application deadline is 30 June 2027
